business_scope.primary_industry_name: Corporate Scope 1-3 Carbon Footprint Auditing and Offset Brokerage

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Samoa — International Company Regime under the International Companies Act 1987
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid — English Common Law (as received) with Samoan customary law and a unitary national statutory overlay
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: China–Samoa Bilateral Investment Treaty (promotion and protection of investments)
Samoa–New Zealand Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement (including exchange of information)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER-Plus) — trade and investment facilitation framework

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 (as amended); Financial Intelligence Unit Act 2007 (as amended); International Companies Act 1987 (as amended), ss. 6–9 and ss. 155–157; International Companies (Amendment) Act 2019 (beneficial ownership record-keeping); Money Laundering Prevention Regulations and AML/CFT directives issued by the Money Laundering Prevention Authority (Samoa Central Bank)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport of each natural-person UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public or Commissioner for Oaths in the UBO's country of domicile
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (certification chain through Samoa Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade and the relevant foreign embassy)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement issued within 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Banker's reference or professional due-diligence reference letter
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Regulated commercial bank or licensed attorney in the origin jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (if the issuing state is an Apostille Convention member) or Consular Legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency or registry extract of a corporate UBO (where the UBO is a body corporate)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies Registry of the corporate UBO's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization according to jurisdiction of issuance

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing for a corporate UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent companies registry of the corporate UBO's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization according to jurisdiction of issuance

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Statutory UBO declaration and source-of-funds statement (Samoan prescribed form)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed Samoan registered agent / Samoa notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Domestic notarization in Samoa (no external consular step)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory CDD screening against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN and Sectoral Sanctions lists, EU/UK consolidated financial sanctions lists, Australian DFAT and New Zealand MFAT autonomous sanctions lists, and Samoa FIU watchlists. PEPs, their family members and close associates are automatically escalated to Enhanced Due Diligence with senior-management written approval and source-of-wealth verification. Adverse media reports and sanctions hits are disqualifying at Stage 1. All records are retained for a minimum of five years after termination of the business relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa Business and Companies Registry e-Services — Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia; applications are routed through MCIL-licensed registered agents and the registry's online clearance facility
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must use Latin (Roman) script; Samoan-language names may include official diacritics (koma liliu and fa'amamafa); any foreign-language name must be transliterated into English; mandatory English suffix of 'Limited', 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Ltd', 'Corp' or 'Inc'
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name rejection notice is issued by the Registrar of International Companies with written grounds. The applicant may file a written reconsideration request within 14 business days, followed by an administrative appeal to the Minister of Commerce, Industry and Labour under s. 12 of the International Companies Act 1987. The final remedy is an application for judicial review to the Supreme Court of Samoa within 30 days of the final administrative decision. Name reservations are valid for 30 days and are renewable once for an additional 30 days upon payment of the prescribed fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible as a substitute for the statutory office. A physical registered office in Samoa maintained by a licensed registered agent is mandatory under s. 155 of the International Companies Act 1987. Back-office and management functions of the ESG/carbon advisory business may be performed remotely from abroad, but the registered agent's physical Apia office remains the legal service address for process service and regulatory filings.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low — approximately 5% annual probability for a Low_Risk_Standard professional-services IC. The Samoa FIU and Central Bank primarily conduct AML/CFT on-site inspections of the licensed registered agent's premises rather than the IC's client-facing offices. Documentary economic-substance queries (approximately 10–15% risk for headquarters-type activities) are more probable than unannounced physical visits.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance preliminary search and reservation fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) Companies Registry
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the Companies (Fees) Regulations

Licensed registered agent and registered office service (year 1)
UBO register preparation, verification and e-filing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark fixed fee per UBO structure

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/KYC CDD and PEP/sanctions screening package
Notarization of passport, address proof and bank references

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Applicable notarial tariff of the jurisdiction of origin

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Consular legalization / apostille of corporate documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Samoa Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade and the relevant embassy/consulate

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certificate of Good Standing and Certificate of Incumbency (pre-incorporation submittal pack)
Legal opinion on ISIC 7020 ESG/carbon-advisory scope and licensing-exemption review
Courier, translation certification and document dispatch
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: International logistics provider and certified translator

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 2018 (Samoa), ss. 5-13 and 45 (incorporation, charter, name, registered office, and records); International Companies Regulations 2018; residual application of the Companies Act 2001 (Samoa) as imported by the International Companies Act 2018.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Financial Authority (SIFA), Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour, Apia, Samoa.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form IC-02 (Application to Incorporate an International Company) together with the executed Charter (Articles of Association) and Declaration of Compliance.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital. The Charter may fix any authorized capital; shares are issued for such consideration as the Board determines, including cash or services. No escrow or capital deposit is required by the Registrar.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the Board approves and accepts the subscription of the initial subscriber for 1,000 no-par-value Ordinary Shares at a fully-paid consideration of US$1,000, and authorises issuance of share certificate(s) accordingly. RESOLVED FURTHER that the registered office of the Company be fixed at the address of the licensed registered agent in Apia, Samoa, and that such agent be engaged on the approved terms. RESOLVED FURTHER that the appointment of each director, the company secretary and the registered agent be ratified, and that the Chairman, Managing Director and Secretary be jointly authorised to sign banking mandates, instruct auditors, and execute all filings and returns. RESOLVED that all acts of the incorporators done prior to incorporation are hereby ratified and confirmed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SIFA Registry, Samoa International Financial Authority (e-SIFA online portal or counter, Apia)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct an availability search in the International Companies Register; submit the name reservation application with the intended business description of corporate carbon footprint auditing and offset brokerage; obtain a Reservation Certificate valid for 30 days.
required_dossiers: Form IC-01 (Name Reservation Application)
Certified copy of passport or incorporation certificate of each proposed member
Brief statement of intended business activities (ISIC 7020 description)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused as undesirable, misleading, or deceptively similar, file alternative names within 5 working days; the Registrar processes the revised application on a priority basis.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Subscriber(s) in coordination with the SIFA-licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Charter (Articles of Association) stating the company name, registered office in Samoa, objects covering management consultancy in carbon auditing and emissions brokerage, authorized share capital, and powers of directors; execute the Charter before a witness; arrange notarization and legalization where the foreign subscriber requires it.
required_dossiers: Final executed Charter (Articles of Association)
Signed consent of each proposed director and secretary
Certified copy of the subscriber's identity or entity documents
Power of attorney appointing the registered agent as incorporator (if applicable)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered agent or notary identifies drafting defects, request a rider or amended Charter pages for re-execution; no additional government fee is triggered for voluntary correction before lodgment.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Lodgment of Incorporation Application with SIFA
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, SIFA Registry, Apia
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the incorporation application package electronically or in person; pay the official state fee (approximately USD 300) and verify that the registered agent's consent is current; the Registrar examines compliance with the International Companies Act 2018 before issuing the Certificate.
required_dossiers: Form IC-02 (Application to Incorporate an International Company)
Executed Charter signed by the subscriber
Declaration of Compliance executed by a director or the registered agent
Written consent of the SIFA-licensed registered agent
Official government fee receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to the Registrar's requisition letter within 14 calendar days; file corrected Charter pages or additional declarations; if rejected, refile with a fresh application and seek a fee credit for the prior filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registrar enters the company in the International Companies Register and issues the Certificate of Incorporation with the unique company number, date of incorporation, and official seal; obtain a certified copy of the Charter and a Certificate of Good Standing for subsequent banking use.
required_dossiers: Approved Form IC-02 with endorsement of the Registrar
Certificate of Incorporation issued by SIFA
Certified extract of the registered Charter
Certificate of Good Standing (optional, for banking)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate contains typographical errors, apply for administrative correction within 10 days; if publication of incorporation is required, submit the certificate to the Official Gazette for filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors and Company Secretary, with the SIFA-licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting in accordance with the Charter; adopt the pro-forma First Board Resolution; issue share certificates; open the statutory registers (members, directors, charges, and officers) at the registered office; execute the banking mandate and open a corporate account supporting SWIFT/Wire transfers for the carbon brokerage business.
required_dossiers: Signed minutes of the first board meeting
Share certificates numbered and countersigned by two directors
Register of members and register of directors and secretary
Notice of registered office at the agent's address in Apia
Bank account opening package with certified incorporation documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a bank rejects the package, obtain a fresh Certificate of Good Standing and certified Charter copies from SIFA within 3 business days; cure any defective director consents by an adjourned board meeting and rescind the invalid resolution.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable — the Samoa International Financial Authority (SIFA) is the sole regulator for International Companies; no industrial licensing board applies to ISIC 7020 advisory, carbon auditing, or offset brokerage activities.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not required — no statutory operating, manufacturing, or trading license is needed for offshore management consultancies and carbon advisory services under the International Companies Act 2018; a physical Apia office, if later established, would require a Business Licence from the Samoa Ministry of Revenue.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Planning and Urban Management Agency (PUMA), Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE), Government of Samoa
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — office-based professional consultancy is not a prescribed activity under the Planning and Urban Management Act 2004, Schedule of Potentially Significant Environmental Impacts; no EIA report or environmental registration letter is required for ISIC 7020 services.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable for office-based operations; if any physical office is established, general waste handling must comply with the Waste Management and Pollution Prevention Act 2012, point-source wastewater discharge requires a Discharge Permit under s. 36, and climate-related deliverables must voluntarily align with ISO 14064-1/3 and the Greenhouse Gas Protocol Scope 1-3 accounting standards.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Occupational Safety and Health at Work Act 2015 (fire safety certification from Samoa Fire Services Authority, hazard assessment, and first-aid provision); structural load and earthquake-wind certifications under the Building Act 2018 for any leased Apia office above three storeys; National Emergency Management Office cyclone preparedness clearance; no civil defense permit is required for a purely virtual registered office.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry of Revenue, Samoa — Online portal: Samoa Tax Online / MoR eServices
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned International Company must register with the Ministry of Revenue using its International Company certificate of incorporation and a completed Taxpayer Registration Form. The Ministry assigns a Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) upon verification. The certificate is issued without requiring domestic incorporation formalities, and the International Company is not required to maintain a registered office in Samoa beyond its registered agent.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Samoa does not operate a check-the-box classification regime. International Companies are statutorily treated as offshore tax-exempt entities under the International Companies Act 1987. No hybrid mismatch or fiscal unity elections are available in the Samoa International Companies regime; a company may elect to be redomiciled or converted to a domestic company, which removes the tax-exempt zone classification.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAGST (Value Added Goods and Services Tax)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: SAT 60,000 per annum of taxable supplies (goods and services); foreign suppliers supplying electronically supplied services to Samoa may be required to register on a simplified basis
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance or digital stamping mandate is in force for International Companies operating under the exempt offshore regime. Standard commercial invoices are acceptable. VAGST returns are filed electronically through the Ministry of Revenue online portal; non-resident suppliers subject to VAGST require an approved electronic filing mechanism.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods and certain offshore services are zero-rated under the VAGST Act 2003 where the supplier is a registered VAGST taxpayer, the goods are exported within 30 days of supply, and supporting evidence demonstrates the recipient is outside Samoa or the service is supplied to a non-resident and used entirely outside Samoa. International Companies carrying out offshore carbon accounting and brokerage services can zero-rate their service fees if all consideration is payable from outside Samoa and the services are consumed wholly outside Samoa.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Signed client service contract evidencing offshore use and non-resident recipient
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent export zero-rating claims attract recovery of uncollected VAGST with interest, a penalty of up to 100% of the tax shortfall, prosecution for tax fraud under the Tax Administration Act 2012, and cancellation of the company's VAGST registration. Directors and officers may face personal liability and fines or imprisonment where wilful evasion is proven. The Ministry of Revenue may issue post-audit assessments and retrospectively claw back any refunded VAGST or tax credits.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (CBS), Faletupe Tutotonu o Samoa, established under the Central Bank of Samoa Act 1984, acting as the designated exchange control authority under the Exchange Control Act 1976 and Exchange Control Regulations 1976, in conjunction with the Minister of Finance for policy approvals; the CBS supervises all authorized dealers in foreign exchange and administers the Samoan Tālā (WST) managed floating exchange rate regime.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The WST is a managed-float currency with current-account transactions largely liberalized, while capital-account movements remain subject to CBS oversight through authorized dealers. A Samoa International Company (IC) regulated under the International Companies Act 1987 is expressly exempted from domestic exchange control restrictions when transacting in foreign currency, provided it does not conduct business with Samoan residents in WST. Profit remittance for an IC is unencumbered in the sense that the entity may hold and transfer foreign-currency proceeds freely through designated foreign-currency accounts; however, any incidental WST-denominated flow, local expenditure with a Samoan resident, or dividend remittance to a Samoan-resident party would trigger CBS conversion/approval requirements. The practical convertibility ceiling is therefore not the statute but the thin onshore interbank market, with USD being the dominant settlement currency and WST deliverability generally confined to domestic settlement.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under CBS administrative practice, resident exporters must repatriate export proceeds to Samoa within 90 days of shipment and offer the proceeds for conversion to authorized dealers in accordance with minimum surrender ratios unless an exporter exemption is granted. A Samoa IC, however, is outside the resident export regime: foreign-currency receipts from carbon auditing and offset brokerage services are not subject to forced surrender or conversion timelines, provided the IC maintains its designated foreign-currency account with an authorized dealer and files the required exchange-control declaration forms evidencing its IC exempt status. Any recommended practice is to keep a documented intercompany or client agreement showing that all invoices are settled in USD or another freely convertible currency and that no goods or services are supplied to Samoan residents in WST.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: USD-denominated International Company Operational Account, plus optional WST Domestic Expense Account strictly segregated for permitted IC administrative costs

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific (BSP) Samoa Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: USD Multi-Currency Operational Account with designated foreign-currency ledger for IC proceeds
USD Operational Account for IC; may require a local director or resident agent co-signatory for enhanced monitoring
Foreign-Currency Corporate Account with manual processing for non-resident IC structures

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low for a Samoa-licensed or Samoa-domiciled electronic money institution (EMI), because Samoa has no dedicated EMI licensing framework and the Offshore Banking Act 1987 contemplates conventional offshore bank licensing rather than digital EMI charters. An offshore EMI incorporated in a recognized jurisdiction (e.g., UK, EU, Singapore, or Hong Kong) may be engaged as a payment conduit for IC fund flows, but legal constraints arise from correspondent de-risking, APG mutual-evaluation scrutiny, and the CBS expectation that foreign-currency deposit-taking for Samoa ICs occurs through authorized dealers. The practical recommended structure is a Samoa IC maintaining a primary account at ANZ or BSP Samoa and a secondary segregated settlement account at a reputable non-Samoa EMI only for low-balance invoice collections, with monthly sweeps to the primary bank to maintain audit trail integrity.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Directors of the Samoa IC must generally appear in person before the bank's compliance officer or a designated correspondent representative for account opening; remote opening is permissible only on a case-by-case basis with a credible introducer (licensed trust company, law firm, or correspondent bank with direct SAMOA KYC responsibility), accompanied by notarized certified copies of passports, the certificate of incorporation, the memorandum and articles of association, a certificate of incumbency issued by the registered agent (under the SIFA regime), and a bank-to-bank reference from the principal operating bank. Where no director can travel, the bank may accept a video‑conference KYC interview recorded by the compliance officer plus hard-copy documents couriered from the registered agent; approval is discretionary and typically adds 5–10 business days to onboarding.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: IC registered with bearer share authority or nominee shareholding without clear beneficial ownership disclosure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full updated register of members and beneficial owners; register of directors; registered agent's letter confirming no bearer shares are outstanding or that all bearer shares have been immobilized; shareholder declaration signed by each ultimate beneficial owner with passport copies and proof of source of funds (bank statements, audited accounts, or previous contract proceeds).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Carbon credit trading counterparties domiciled in high-risk or sanctioned jurisdictions or using digital-asset settlement
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sanctions screening report of all counterparties; legal entity identification documents for each counterparty (CRS/GLEIF registration if available); contract suite evidencing the underlying carbon offset transaction; independent verification report from a recognized carbon registry (e.g., Verra, Gold Standard); and a written AML explanation that proceeds settle exclusively by SWIFT wire, never via crypto.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Disproportionate USD transaction velocity relative to declared employee/service footprint in Samoa
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Operating budget and headcount report; subcontractor agreements with invoices; office lease or registered agent attestation; monthly reconciliation of funds outflows to advisory mandates; confirmation that the IC has no Samoan-resident customers and maintains only the permitted administrative-expense WST account.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Intent to sweep funds rapidly from Samoa to a third-country trust or family office without underlying economic activity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Economic substance filing (where applicable) or voluntary substance disclosure; flow-of-funds memorandum; audited or reviewed financial statements demonstrating fee income from ESG carbon services; board resolution approving treasury policy; copy of the client engagement and delivery of the carbon audit/offset report; and confirmation that the ultimate beneficiary is the trust/family structure documented in the IC's corporate register.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant routing requires subscription proceeds for IC shares or shareholder loans to be remitted by SWIFT MT103/MT202 from the investor's bank into the IC's designated USD account at ANZ or BSP Samoa via the Samoan bank's offshore USD correspondent (typically a New York or Australian clearing bank). The remittance must carry a precise purpose narrative such as 'Share Capital Subscription – Samoa International Company (WS/IC) – Carbon Advisory Services' or 'Shareholder Loan - ESG Audit Working Capital'; the beneficiary account name must exactly match the IC's registered name, and the Samoan bank will require a certificate of incorporation, shareholder resolution approving the issuance, and a capital verification letter from the registered agent or auditor. CBS exchange-control declaration forms (E1/FX1) must be lodged if any portion of the transfer is converted to WST; otherwise, the foreign-currency account is maintained without conversion approval. For any capital injection exceeding USD 500,000 per month, the bank may require a source-of-funds letter and board minutes confirming the purpose, with funds held in the IC's operational account until deployment to carbon offset purchases or audit deliverables.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails for outbound trade settlements: (1) SWIFT MT103 for immediate wire transfers covering carbon offset brokerage fees, subcontractor audit payments, and reimbursable client expenses; (2) Commercial Letter of Credit (LC) fundamentally limited in applicability because the underlying service-based business (ESG auditing and carbon offset brokerage) does not generate shipping documentation, although an LC may be issued on a revolving clean basis for verified carbon credit purchases where the seller demands payment security; (3) Promissory-note-backed settlement or documentary collections are available but not market standard. For all outbound rails, the Samoan bank will require full beneficiary bank details (BIC/IBAN), a supporting invoice or credit-purchase contract, and an FX declaration if conversion into WST is involved; the practical clearing corridor is the bank's correspondent in New York (USD) or Sydney/Auckland (AUD/NZD), with same-day value for USD wires and T+1 for AUD/NZD. Where carbon credit settlement requires payment to registry administrators (e.g., Verra, Gold Standard), the bank will expect the registry reference and the serialized credit list to remain attached to the payment instruction.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable outright forward (USD/WST) transacted with an authorized dealer for confirmed future WST expenditure, subject to CBS forward-cover approval where the IC has incidental resident-facing costs

Offshore non-deliverable forward (NDF) in USD/WST executed with a recognized international bank (e.g., via Australia, Singapore, or Hong Kong) to hedge translation exposure of any WST-denominated balance, given WST is not freely deliverable offshore

Cross-currency swap (USD/WST) under ISDA documentation executed offshore with a licensed swap counterparty, permissible where aggregate notional is supported by a signed treasury policy and where the Samoa IC maintains no speculative position; settlement risk is mitigated via ISDA master netting and credit support annex

Plain-vanilla FX spot for all conversion needs is the default permissible instrument; vanilla FX options and innovative hedge structures are not available onshore in Samoan banks and require the involvement of a licensed offshore broker-dealer, which may raise product-appropriateness and KYC review hurdles under the bank's derivatives acceptance policy

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Fee (Annual Licence Fee) with Certificate of Compliance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) via the Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the anniversary of incorporation; a 60-day grace period is routinely applied before penalties accrue
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late surcharge of 10% of the outstanding fee; if unpaid for 6 consecutive months the Registrar may administratively strike the company off the register; directors remain personally liable for debts incurred during default

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Confirmation Statement (Annual Return) of Company Particulars and Registered Office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days of the anniversary of incorporation, filed concurrently with the annual government fee
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monthly late-filing penalty of WST 50; non-filing for 12 months empowers the Registrar to initiate deregistration with notice published in the Samoan Gazette

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Re-verification and AML/CDD Refresh
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: SIFA-licensed Registered Agent (AML/CFT records held at the Apia registered office)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: At each annual renewal, no later than the anniversary of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Continuing failure to maintain current UBO records is an offence under the Samoa AML Act 2007 with fines on the agent and officers; client non-cooperation permits agent resignation, precipitating administrative strike-off

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory audit thresholds apply under the International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa); a statutory audit is triggered only if members holding not less than 10% of issued shares or voting power serve a written audit request; revenue, asset, and employee size are irrelevant for International Companies
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: The Act does not mandate local GAAP; financial statements may be prepared under IFRS, US GAAP, or any framework acceptable to the directors, provided records fairly present the financial position and permit a true and fair audit

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The register of members must be updated within 14 days of any share transfer; the registered agent must annually re-verify beneficial owners at the anniversary renewal and log any changes, even if no transfer occurred; Samoa maintains no public UBO filing, but the agent must retain beneficial ownership records for 5 years post-termination and produce them to the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit on request

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 900 - 2,000 per annum for a SIFA-licensed registered agent, including the statutory registered office in Apia
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not compulsory in the ordinary case; if member-requested, a Samoan Chartered Accountant will typically charge USD 3,500 - 10,000 depending on the complexity of the carbon-offset ledger

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% for an International Company (IC) under the International Companies Act 1987 as amended; the general domestic corporate tax rate for resident taxable companies is 27% under the Income Tax Act 2015.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: The IC is granted a permanent statutory tax holiday: exemption from corporate income tax, dividend/interest/royalty withholding tax, stamp duty, and capital gains tax on non-Samoa-sourced income. The only annual fiscal charge is the government license fee payable to the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA), calculated on authorized capital. A purely domestic ESG carbon auditing and offset brokerage entity would be taxable at 27%.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: International Company Annual Return (prescribed form under the International Companies Act 1987, as amended), electronically filed with the Registrar of International Companies through the SIFA online registry portal; submission is made by the licensed registered agent.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on or before the anniversary of the date of incorporation each year; a statutory grace period of 3 months applies before late penalties accrue. The annual government fee must accompany the return to avoid default.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered company number, exact corporate name, date of incorporation, physical registered office address in Samoa, and the name of the licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered office must be a physical Apia address, not a post office box; the registered agent must be a licensed Samoa trustee or company management firm.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of issued shares, class rights, paid-up capital, and full legal names and residential addresses of all shareholders.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Ultimate beneficial owners must be disclosed through any nominee layers; SIFA conducts AML/CFT verification. For non-resident corporate shareholders attach a certificate of incorporation and an ownership chain statement.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names, nationality, residential address, and signed consent to act of each director and the company secretary.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Samoa does not require Samoan-resident directors; foreign nationals may serve, but the registered agent must hold due diligence files, including passport copies and proof of address.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the IC has not carried on business with residents of Samoa, has not held real property in Samoa, and has not derived Samoan-source income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A carbon offset brokerage serving a Samoa-resident client or negotiating contracts within Samoa breaches this declaration and forfeits the exemption; the declaration must certify the absence of all local activity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computation of the annual government fee based on authorized capital and proof of payment.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Remit by SWIFT wire to the SIFA account and retain the payment receipt in the corporate records; the registered agent files the proof with the return.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers a per-month surcharge on the annual fee with a statutory cap; persistent default beyond 3 months leads to administrative strike-off, forfeiture of assets to the Registrar, and restoration only by court order with payment of all arrears. False statements in the return are punishable by fines and imprisonment under the International Companies Act 1987.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Domestic context only: Samoa Revenue Corporation (SRC) Company Income Tax Return (self-assessment), filed electronically via the SRC online filing portal. Not applicable to the tax-exempt IC unless the IC's exemption is forfeited.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The income year is the calendar year; the return and final self-assessment are due by 30 April of the following year. Provisional tax installments are payable on the last day of months 4, 7, 10, and 13 of the income year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Aggregate turnover from carbon auditing and offset brokerage services, gross of expenses and before deductions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Do not use this form for the IC; this line applies only to a Samoa-resident operating company that has lost or never held IC status.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible business expenses under the Income Tax Act 2015, including subcontract audit fees, software, professional fees, and depreciation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The IC must not file deductions because its income is exempt; erroneous filing creates audit exposure and may be treated as a taxable election.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts a penalty of up to 10% of the tax payable plus incremental late-payment interest; continued default triggers a default assessment and enforced collection. Willful tax evasion is a criminal offense carrying imprisonment.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% for dividends and distributions paid by a Samoa International Company to non-resident shareholders, because IC distributions are excluded from the Income Tax Act 2015 withholding regime. Dividends paid by a domestic Samoan resident company to non-residents are subject to a 15% statutory withholding rate.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: For IC distributions, no treaty relief application is required because the payment is exempt at source; the paying IC should retain an IC remittance statement from its registered agent. For a domestic Samoan payer claiming a reduced DTA rate, the non-resident beneficial owner must: (1) obtain an original Tax Residence Certificate (TRC) from its home tax authority; (2) complete the SRC treaty relief declaration before the payment date; (3) evidence beneficial ownership and, for dividend relief, the minimum shareholding period; (4) obtain SRC written confirmation of the applicable rate; and (5) instruct the payer to withhold at the treaty rate. Samoa's DTA network is limited to China and the Nordic states (Denmark, Finland, Norway, Sweden); payments to residents of all other jurisdictions remain at the 15% domestic rate.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Domestic statutory rates: 15% for interest and 15% for royalties paid by a Samoan resident company to a non-resident. Under the Samoa-China DTA, interest and royalties are each reduced to 10% subject to beneficial ownership; the Nordic DTAs provide comparable limited reductions. Payments involving an IC are exempt at source and are not subject to these statutory rates unless a domestic Samoan payer is interposed.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: None in Samoa: the Income Tax Act 2015 contains general transfer pricing provisions empowering the Commissioner to adjust non-arm's length international related-party transactions, but Samoa has not enacted OECD-aligned Local File or Master File documentation thresholds, nor a Country-by-Country reporting obligation. For the target IC, contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation is not required in Samoa; however, a foreign parent or investor will be required to apply its own transfer pricing and CbCR rules, so the IC should maintain pricing records for intercompany ESG audit fees and carbon credit brokerage commissions in line with the OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Samoa has not enacted a full Economic Substance Regulations statute comparable to BVI or Cayman. The applicable substance doctrine derives from the International Companies Act 1987 as amended (including the 2020 amendments adopted following Samoa's alignment with OECD/EU requirements). An IC must maintain a registered office and licensed registered agent in Samoa, keep books and records at the registered office, and must not carry on business with Samoa residents. The amended regime requires an annual compliance certification that the IC maintains sufficient presence and activity consistent with its stated business. A pure letterbox carbon offset brokerage with no operational capacity is high risk: it may be re-characterized as carrying on business in Samoa (forfeiting the tax exemption) or treated as an unlawful shell under the harmful tax practices standard.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately concealing income, falsifying the IC Annual Return, misstating beneficial ownership, or diverting Samoan-source carbon audit fees through the exempt IC while the economic activity is performed in Samoa.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Income Tax Act 2015 and the Crimes Act 2013, conviction is punishable by a fine of up to WST 100,000 and/or imprisonment for up to 7 years. The revenue authority will assess tax on all concealed profits at 27%, add late-payment penalties and compound interest, and may revoke the IC exemption and strike off the company.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and shadow directors who sign false returns commit an indictable offense and are personally liable for the unpaid tax where the company is a sham or fraudulent trading is proven. Piercing the corporate veil exposes directors to civil restitution, asset freezing, travel bans, and imprisonment for up to 7 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and Deficient Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the IC as a pure letterbox conduit for carbon offset brokering without the mandated records, physical files, and annual substance certification; placing no real activity in Samoa while claiming the IC exemption; or failing to pay annual fees for more than 3 months.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the International Companies Act 1987 as amended, the penalties include late-fee surcharges, administrative strike-off after 3 months' notice, dissolution with forfeiture of assets to the Registrar, disqualification of directors from managing an IC for up to 5 years, and retroactive loss of zero-tax status.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be disqualified and fined for wrongful trading. If the shell is used to defeat foreign tax claims, Samoan courts may pierce the corporate veil on sham grounds, exposing directors to restitution orders, anti-dissipation injunctions, and personal liability for the avoided tax.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML/CFT Violations in Carbon Offset Brokerage
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting tainted funds, converting proceeds of crime through the offset brokerage escrow, failing to maintain beneficial ownership and transaction records at the registered office, using unlicensed nominees to avoid the registered agent's customer due diligence, or structuring payments to evade reporting thresholds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 as amended, money laundering offenses are punishable by imprisonment for up to 14 years and fines of up to WST 1,000,000 for individuals, with higher penalties for corporate bodies. Record-keeping failures attract separate fines, and assets involved in laundering are subject to confiscation and international freezing orders.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers who knowingly authorize or permit laundering are personally liable; the corporate veil is expressly pierced under the AML statute. Civil forfeiture may extend to bonuses and dividends derived from the scheme, criminal travel bans prevent departure from Samoa pending trial, and imprisonment applies on conviction.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Prohibited Local Activity and Loss of IC Exemption
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Selling carbon audit or offset services to Samoa-resident clients, negotiating contracts with Samoa residents, holding a lease over Samoan land for an Apia office, or managing the business from Samoa in violation of the International Companies Act 1987 restrictions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The IC ceases to be tax-exempt: the Samoa Revenue Corporation assesses 27% corporate tax on all Samoan-source profits, plus penalties and interest. The company may be ordered to convert to a domestic company, and the Registrar may impose fines and strike-off for repeated contraventions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors become jointly and severally liable for the assessed corporate tax and penalties if they knowingly permitted prohibited local trading. Senior managers face personal fines and, on proof of fraudulent intent, imprisonment under the International Companies Act 1987 and the Income Tax Act 2015, with exit restrictions pending resolution.
